primaryRawText:
The G Gold series consists of dependable power supply units
for entry level users and system integrators. The quiet 120mm
fan, 80 PLUS Gold efficiency, and 5 year warranty deliver a
PSU that provides function and resilience you can count on. It’s
the perfect option for pre-built office and gaming systems. This
power supply has been engineered for reliability with a focus on
maximizing performance while remaining cost effective. And
with 2 EPS connectors, it's compatible with all current
motherboard models. The G Gold is a complete solution,
offering performance, efficiency, and stability at a low cost.
80 PLUS Gold Certified : This certification guarantees a typical
efficiency of 90% under normal operating conditions.
Intel ATX 12V version 2.52 : This PSU meets all performance
specifications up to Intel ATX version 2.52 standards.
Hydro Dynamic Fan Bearing : The 120mm HDB fan creates less
friction at lower speeds, for a longer lifespan and quiet operation.
2 EPS Connectors : Every G series unit comes with 2 EPS connectors,
ensuring compatibility with all motherboards currently on the market.
High Temperature Resistance : This unit can operate safely in
temperatures up to 40℃.
5 Year Warranty : This unit comes with a standard limited
manufacturing warranty of 5 years from the date of purchase.
